title: Spermine and spermidine SI-PPCs: Molecular dynamics reveals enhanced biomolecular interactions.
authors: Ferreira, Frederico Henrique do C; Farrell, Nicholas P; Costa, Luiz Antonio S
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学研究铂多核复合物与DNA及肝素的静电/氢键相互作用，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关界面机制，但对象为小分子-DNA体系而非TF-DNA，方法可迁移但匹配度中等。
abstract: In this paper the effects on the interaction of highly positively charged substitution-inert platinum polynuclear complexes (SI-PPCs) with negatively charged DNA and heparin are examined and compared by theoretical chemistry methods. Electrostatic and hydrogen bonding interactions contribute to the overall effects on the biomolecule. Root Mean Square (RMS) deviation, Solvent Accessible Surface, RMS fluctuation, and interaction analysis all confirm similar effects on both biomolecules, dictated predominantly by the total positive charge and total number of hydrogen bonds formed. Especially, changes in structural parameters suggesting condensation and reduction of available surface area will reduce or prevent normal protein recognition and may thus potentially inhibit biological mechanisms related to apoptosis (DNA) or reduced vascularization viability (HEP). Thermodynamic analyses supported these findings with favourable interaction energies. The comparison of DNA and heparin confirms the general intersectionality between the two biomolecules and confirms the intrinsic dual-nature function of this chemotype. The distinction between the two-limiting mode of actions (HS or DNA-centred) could reflect an intriguing balance between extracellular (GAG) and intracellular (DNA) binding and affinities. The results underline the need to fully understand GAG-small molecule interactions and their contribution to drug pharmacology and related therapeutic modalities. This report contributes to that understanding.
abstract_zh: 本文通过理论化学方法，研究并比较了高正电荷取代惰性铂多核配合物（SI-PPCs）与带负电的DNA和肝素之间的相互作用效应。静电和氢键相互作用对生物分子的整体效应均有贡献。均方根偏差（RMS）、溶剂可及表面积、均方根波动及相互作用分析均证实了两种生物分子上的相似效应，这些效应主要由总正电荷和形成的总氢键数量决定。特别是，结构参数的变化表明缩合和可用表面积的减少将降低或阻止正常蛋白质识别，从而可能抑制与凋亡（DNA）或血管生成活力降低（HEP）相关的生物机制。热力学分析以有利的相互作用能量支持了这些发现。DNA与肝素的比较证实了两种生物分子之间的普遍交叉性，并确认了该化学型固有的双重功能特性。两种主要作用模式（HS或DNA中心）之间的区别可能反映了细胞外（GAG）与细胞内（DNA）结合及亲和力之间的微妙平衡。结果强调需全面理解GAG-小分子相互作用及其对药物药理学和相关治疗模式的贡献。本报告有助于增进这一理解。
